faqs.a:
(a)
The city manager may, after public hearing, adopt rules and regulations governing
               the use of public parks within the city. Such rules and regulations may be adopted
               as are reasonable and necessary to ensure the safe, orderly and efficient use of the
               public parks in accordance with the laws of the city.
(b)
Upon adoption of such rules and regulations, three copies thereof shall be filed in
               the office of the city clerk and shall be kept available for public inspection during
               regular business hours.
(Code 1960, § 17-36; Code 1981, § 22-14)
